judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a `.lore/dod.md` planning file and a failing acceptance test suite (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without implementing any production code. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, `ErrorCodes`, specs, or documentation were made. Furthermore, the acceptance test file passes `{history: {enabled: true}}` to `startEngineWith`, which does not yet accept a `history` option, causing TypeScript compilation and tests to fail. Even within the test helper `ask`, sending `ping` immediately after `list_conversations` without waiting for the response creates a race condition when `listFor` is asynchronous.
